chapters.title: Judgment on the neighbors
chapters.summary: Amos, a shepherd from Tekoa, announces God's judgment on the nations around Israel for their cruelty in war: for three transgressions, and for four.

chapters.title: Judah and Israel judged
chapters.summary: Then the judgment turns to Judah and to Israel, who sell the righteous for silver and trample the poor.

chapters.title: Can two walk together?
chapters.summary: God chose Israel, so He will hold them accountable. Can two walk together unless they agree? God reveals His secrets to His prophets.

chapters.title: Prepare to meet your God
chapters.summary: The wealthy women of Samaria oppress the poor. God sent famine, drought and plague, yet Israel did not return. Prepare to meet your God.

chapters.title: Let justice roll down
chapters.summary: Seek the Lord and live. God hates Israel's festivals while injustice continues: let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like a mighty stream.

chapters.title: Woe to the complacent
chapters.summary: Woe to those at ease in Zion, lounging on ivory beds while ignoring the ruin of their people.

chapters.title: The plumb line
chapters.summary: Amos sees locusts, fire, and a plumb line held against a wall. The priest Amaziah tells him to go home, but Amos says God took him from following the flock.

chapters.title: A famine of the word
chapters.summary: A basket of summer fruit shows Israel is ripe for judgment. A famine is coming, not of bread, but of hearing the words of the Lord.

chapters.title: David's tent restored
chapters.summary: No one can escape God's judgment. Yet He will raise up the fallen tent of David and plant His people in their land, never to be uprooted.
